review: Requests: at round 9 Lin (health 100, energy 40, owning nothing, with the hazelnut plant start-1-nuts and its five units in view and own food records for berries only) asked for a feasible way to prepare gathered hazelnuts into food with the necessary safety checks and processing, naming tools and materials instead of assuming them; Sol (on forest floor near the visible berry plant forest-berry-1, owning only the berry stack item-2-sol-25, with no tools or drawing skill) asked to make a simple visible drawing from direct observation of a nearby subject on an actually suitable surface, presuming no beauty, satisfaction or reward. World Agent decisions: develop (learning 2) a general prepare shelled food(targetStack, quantity, mode inspect|shell, supportRef?, implementRef?): inspection at 0.2 energy per unit for visible maturity, shell damage, mould, infestation and spoilage with suspect portions rejected; shelling over two active rounds at 0.5 energy each per unit (positioning and fracture, then separation and kernel inspection) only with a real clean, stable, hard support and a suitable blunt implement, or a hand method the specimen allows; conserved fractional shell and kernel accounting from the resource definition, implemented if missing; shells and rejects kept as waste; the output an unverified shelled specimen, not certified food; reservation, pause, resumption, cancellation and death rules; and develop (learning 2) a general draw from observation(subjectRef, surfaceRef, method finger-groove|implement-groove|material-mark, implementRef?, markingStackRef?, extent, strokes) whose first executable mode is finger-groove: a one-round, 0.5-energy suitability trial whose test groove stays even on failure, then two active rounds at 0.5 energy with at most six short strokes inside 0.3 by 0.3, a visible nearby subject, exposed fine yielding soil, no pigment, persistence subject to actual trampling, weather and surface changes, other modes only with their real prerequisites, and reconciliation with mark. Implemented: prepare-shelled-food@1 (ability prepare-shelled-food, handler long.prepare-shelled-food, equivalence food:shelled:inspect-shell-batch:1, from a new shelledFoodPackage(id, scope, compositions) factory in long-ex22-shelled-food.ts; 3,425 code units) and draw-from-observation@1 (ability draw-from-observation, handler long.draw-from-observation, equivalence surface:observational-drawing:finger-groove:1, from observationalDrawingPackage(id, scope) in long-ex22-observational-drawing.ts; 3,367 code units), both learning 2 without study energy, dependency foundation-open@1, appended last to the package list. Lin's package: inspect (targetStack, an own unreserved, untreated item of a material with represented shell and kernel; quantity 1-5 whole units, default 1) needs light and 0.2 energy per unit, pays it in one round and records by eye ripeness (taken as ripe stock from a plant), shell state, the examine-food deterioration class and spoilage, stating that mould and infestation are not represented in this world; spoiled or visibly deteriorated units are split off as an own rejected item of the same, physically unchanged material and are refused for shelling; events shelled-food-inspect-started, -defect-observed and -inspected and an unverified personal record. shell reserves the batch from the exact stack in a work record (workCreate, workAllocations, workReserve) and works one unit at a time: a press round (0.5) positions one unit and compresses it with implementRef (an own whole, hard, sound inedible piece carrying no treatment, by the ex19 and ex20 piece and contact checks) on supportRef (a solid, unreserved, visible inedible object in reach that is not a plant or animal and has no loose item lying on it, or another such own piece on firm ground where the person stands), or by hand with neither; under the ex17/ex19/ex20 law (strength = hardness / 10; the lower of implement and support strength x (1 - flexibility); a bare hand 0.1 / unit mass^(2/3) from hand-break-food) a load at or below the shell strength leaves it intact, an explicit unmet-prerequisite result (shelled-food-failed) that pauses the work and makes the same method refused for that work and, through the verified record, for new works; above it damage (load - strength) / strength accumulates on the unit, cracked below 1 and split open at 1 (shelled-food-pressed, shelled-food-shell-cracked); a separation round (0.5) turns the split unit into an own hazelnut-kernel item of 0.4 and an own hazelnut-shell item of 0.6, both carrying the unit's origin, harvest tick and decay and a processing record (work, unit, method, implement, support); the kernel is inspected by eye and marked unverified shelled specimen with certified false and no treatment, or rejected when visibly deteriorated, and the shell is marked waste; a per-unit ledger input = kernel + shell + rejects + losses (losses 0) and batch totals are kept (shelled-food-kernel-separated, shelled-food-completed). With an own stone on the start-1-stone rock a hazelnut splits in one press, so each unit takes exactly two rounds and 1 energy; an oak piece only cracks it and takes extra press rounds. shell continues round by round (state-dependent duration); an unworked round, darkness, too little energy, an out-of-reach or unclean support or a spoiled unit pauses at no charge (shelled-food-paused) and the next paid round emits shelled-food-resumed; cancel (no energy) returns reserved units as they now are (an opened unit keeps its record and a new work separates it in one round) and keeps all outputs (shelled-food-stopped); death drops reserved units once where the person fell (shelled-food-stopped, cause death); a reserved unit that spoils ends the work and returns the rest (shelled-food-failed, material lost); nothing is refunded and everything is owner-only. Sol's package: test (surfaceRef ground at x, y, a point within 0.5 that the person sees now and that is not water, under a body or inside any object footprint; extent 0.05-0.3, default 0.3; method finger-groove; optional subjectRef) needs light and 0.5 energy, pays one round and makes one 0.05 test groove at the patch centre, creating a non-solid groove-drawing ground object even when the soil fails (ground-drawing-tested, plus ground-drawing-failed with the measured reason); draw (subjectRef seen now; 1-6 strokes of 2-8 points inside the patch, each at most extent long) traces half the strokes per paid round, two rounds at 0.5 energy (one round for a single stroke), appending each groove to the object (ground-drawing-stroke) and rechecking the subject's visibility, reach, seen ground, the tested soil, the objects reaching the patch (its surface revision), light and energy, refusing before the first round and pausing at no charge afterwards (ground-drawing-paused, then ground-drawing-resumed), as an unworked round also does; completion means the planned strokes were made, not that they depict the subject well (ground-drawing-completed); cancel keeps partial grooves (ground-drawing-cancelled); death ends the work and leaves them (ground-drawing-ended); verified personal records hold the soil result and the strokes made; work is owner-only and no new test can be made over an existing drawing. The object carries surface-local polylines, width, depth, groove colour, contrast, displaced soil, bounds, subject reference, completed strokes, status (test groove only, partial, completed or unsuitable), a change list with its revision number, pigment none and durability untested. implement-groove and material-mark are declared and refused before any charge, naming the missing implement or marking stack and, when one is present, why the mode stays unavailable. Modeling assumptions: (1) the hazelnut composition (kernel 0.4 and shell 0.6 by mass, all food value and toxicity in the kernel, a split shell releasing the whole kernel) and the derived part rows are ex20's unchanged definitions, installed here as this package's resources; (2) a batch is at most five whole units, the plant's stock; (3) every unit of one stack shares one decay, so inspection judges the selected portion as one, and suspect means spoiled or at least observable deterioration under the examine-food classes; (4) a press that only cracks the shell adds another 0.5 press round, since the specified two rounds assume a press that splits it; (5) a support is clean when no loose item lies on it and, for an own piece, when it carries no treatment, because no dirt is otherwise represented; it is stable as a solid object or as an own piece on firm ground; implement and support are not worn because they are stronger than the shell under the same law, and the hand is not between the surfaces; (6) crushing is not represented, so fragments are 0; (7) the resource definition holds no preparation rule and no identification of hazelnuts is acquired, so kernels stay unverified specimens; (8) fine, yielding soil is forest floor and meadow ground; rocky ground does not yield; water, a wet bank (moisture 0.9) and waterlogging above 0.1 (the ex19 and ex20 threshold) flow back; drying soil is not treated differently because no crumbling rule exists; (9) a finger groove is 0.02 wide (ex20's finger width) and 0.01 deep, and it shows by the shade of its walls: the ground tone of ex20's terrain palette darkened by the share of sky hidden at the centre of a long trench, 1 - 1/sqrt(1 + (2 depth / width)^2) = 0.293, giving #3a4734 at contrast 0.0987 on forest floor (#52644a) and 0.1387 on meadow, visible from ex20's 0.05; light gates the work by the ex19 daylight rule and is recorded; displaced soil (length x width x depth) is recorded as pushed to the groove edges and is not portable stock; (10) a nearby subject is any object the person sees now within the vision radius; (11) strokes are offsets from the test groove, split evenly over the two rounds; (12) the climate has a rain value, but its represented effects act on shelters, fires, canopies and drying food, and no trampling or erosion rule exists, so grooves stay as made and durability is recorded as untested (a test runs rainy rounds with a person standing on a drawing); (13) implement-groove is unavailable because soil has no represented material strength, so implement wear cannot be accounted, and material-mark because this operation represents no per-stroke deposit, residue and waste accounting; (14) a drawing occupies its footprint, so retracing or redrawing over an existing drawing is not offered. Reuse and reconciliation: Lin's package reuses ex20's HAZELNUT_COMPOSITION and enclosedResources and, through an appended read-only export SAMPLE_OPENING_LAWS, ex20's compression law, bare-hand load and deterioration classes; the ex19 shared light, piece, contact, firm-ground and whole-unit checks; ex16's hand force through the ex20 load; the collective-work escrow and paid-work helpers, openRemember, tenths accounting and material portions; the ex20 factory was not extended because its argument names, modes, costs, events and ability text all differ, and base gather, probe and eat stay separate, unchanged actions. Sol's package reuses, through an appended read-only export SURFACE_MARKING_SHARED, ex20's hand reach 0.5, finger width, stroke stepping, ground palette, colour distance and visibility threshold, together with openConditions, the ex19 light rule and the collective-work helpers; the expression mark interface is a text sign of up to 120 characters without geometry or physical effect, and probe acts only on objects and owned material, so neither is equivalent and neither was reused for the groove; apply-marking-material is not installed in this scope and its applied-mark drawing needs a deposit, so a separate groove-drawing kind and drawing were added, with no shadow in the forest canvas, every existing drawing unchanged and a viewer test. Every ex19, ex20 and ex21 package is byte-identical (the sha256 of each JSON.stringify is asserted in a test); one ex21 test assertion that its package is the very last in the list was narrowed to the last package of its own scope. A throwaway check on the archived round-9 world had Lin navigate, gather two hazelnuts, study two rounds, inspect them (0.4 energy), fail by hand (0.5), fetch a stone from start-1-stone and shell both on that rock in four rounds (2 energy), ending with two 0.4 kernels and two 0.6 shells, while Sol studied two rounds, tested the forest floor at (13.3, 16.58) (0.5) and drew three strokes from forest-berry-1 in two rounds (1 energy) with the berries untouched; it was deleted afterwards. No practice milestone (the completion events carry no qualified flag), satisfaction, pleasure, comfort, nutrition or energy reward is added; the optional short pleasure was not added because no installed package grants it for ordinary non-protected events. What they can do now: Lin can inspect hazelnuts and, holding a hard implement at a hard support, shell them into unverified kernel and shell items, but a bare hand cannot crack a hazelnut and a 0.4 kernel cannot be eaten through eat, which takes whole units; Sol can test a soil patch and finger-draw up to six strokes of a subject in view. First release: no; both specifications are self-consistent and are implemented as simplified but real mechanisms with real costs, state changes and events; only the two optional drawing modes stay unavailable, as the specification allows while their prerequisites are absent.
